title: Little Rusty Bulldog Revolver
yarn_note: Made with light (DK, CYC 3) yarn and a 3.0 mm hook, which is smaller than the yarn label suggests so the fabric is tight and the stuffing does not show. The finished size is based on this yarn and hook. A thinner or thicker yarn makes the piece smaller or larger, so check your gauge first.

assembly: Sew the open end of the Barrel to the front of the Frame, slightly above the middle, so it points forward.
Sew the Cylinder on top of the Frame, directly behind the Barrel, with its length running in the same direction as the Barrel.
Sew the open end of the Grip to the bottom back of the Frame, angled backward and down like a revolver butt.
Hammer: with steel gray, ch 7, sc in the 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across (6 sc). Fasten off. Sew one end to the top back of the Frame and let the other end curve backward.
Trigger guard: with steel gray, ch 14, sc in the 2nd ch from hook and in each ch across (13 sc). Fasten off. Sew both ends under the Frame in front of the Grip to make a small loop.
notes: Use a stitch marker and work in a continuous spiral. Stuff the Frame and Grip firmly, but keep the Frame slightly flat so the toy stays slim. For the rusty look, embroider a few small spots on the Barrel and Cylinder with wood brown yarn.
